lines.speaker: Tatay
lines.text: Kumusta ang anak naming matibay? Kahit pagod ka sa {course}, lagi mong tandaan: hindi ka nag-iisa. Pinagmamalaki ka namin sa buong barangay!
lines.textEn: How is our toughest scholar doing? Even when {course} wears you down, remember you are never alone. The whole barangay hears how proud we are of you!

choices.text: Magkwento nang masaya kay Mama at Tatay (+20 Mental, +Family).
choices.textEn: Share all your recent wins with Mama and Tatay (+20 Mental, +Family).

choices.text: Magpadala ng ₱250 pambili ng pansit para sa Sunday dinner nila (-₱250, ++Family).
choices.textEn: Send ₱250 to treat them to Sunday pancit (-₱250, ++Family).

lines.speaker: Mama
lines.text: Dumating na ang balikbayan box! May bagong sapatos, chocolates, at bonus padala para sa tuition mo, {name} — pero nami-miss na talaga namin ang Pasko nang kumpleto.
lines.textEn: The balikbayan box arrived! New shoes, chocolates, and extra tuition money for you, {name} — though we miss spending Christmas all together.

choices.text: I-video call agad ang OFW parent mo at ipangakong magtatapos ka (+₱600, +Mental).
choices.textEn: Video call your OFW parent immediately and vow to make them proud (+₱600, +Mental).
